## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Direction: absence is loud at the HTTP surface too, with the one remedy picker

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T09:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the Console mount, the `--ui` help text) and `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: that lane's.

- **Why p3:** after PR #22224 the terminal already names the remedy, and the HTTP 404 is the remaining half. The help text names a package the resolver never reads, but nothing breaks.
- **Reuse `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning`** for the remedy. ⛔ No second picker. `GET /`: the PR states its choice.
- **Pins:** both HTTP answers with no Console built. Control: with a built Console the SPA is served.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22225-console-not-built-loud`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22225`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface: `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, only the `--ui` flag description (about `:1200`) and the Console mount branch with its comment (about `:5081`-`:5110`); `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, the not-built answer reusing `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning`; `packages/cli/README.md`'s `--ui` row; tests beside them under `packages/cli/src/utils/` or `packages/cli/test/`; `.changeset/22225-*.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` prints "no path-derived mandate". The `GET /` choice (answer or redirect) is this card's design call.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` with `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` (this lane's Console mount) answers a bare 404 when no Console is built | the boot warning `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning` (PR #22224) names the remedy in the terminal only, not at the HTTP surface | anyone browsing `/_console/` or `/` on a fresh source checkout reaches it; it is used today (measured on #22155)
Thread-read: 6056508261
Serial constraints cleared: `console.ts`: #22237's hold is released (PR #22395 landed as `a55fdc470b`). `serve.ts`: not a single-claim path (`scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs` lists only `.objectui-sha`), so sharing it is ordinary concurrency. PR #22381 (#22301 stage 2, `domain:spec` seat 2, held draft) edits `serve.ts` at hunks near `:28`, `:949`, `:1595`, `:1856` and `:4422` at its head. This card's regions (`:1200`, `:5081`-`:5110`) are disjoint from those, and whichever PR lands second merges `main`. No other open PR touches `console.ts`, `serve.ts` or the README (the REST file lists of the open PRs, read in this round).

## ACCEPT: PR #22419 (head `813ff4827`)

<sub>`domain:cli` seat (#6024) · `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS` · 2026-10-09T04:54Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not against the report.</sub>

- **PR shape:** draft, base `main`; the first line is `Fixes #22225`, the only closing keyword in the body, and the body carries a line-initial `Clause-②: no`. Six files, `+305 / -14`, all inside the claim's surface:
  - `serve.ts` (the `--ui` text and the mount branch only, disjoint from PR #22381's hunks);
  - `console.ts`;
  - `README.md`'s `--ui` row;
  - a new `console.not-built.test.ts`;
  - `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` (the new export joins the internal-only list);
  - `.changeset/22225-console-not-built-loud.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch).
- **Diff read:**
  - `describeConsoleDistMissing(consolePath, hostPaths)` is now the one remedy picker. `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning` renders it with host paths, so the terminal text is byte-identical. `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin` renders it without absolute host paths, because its reader is anonymous.
  - The plugin mounts on exactly the boot that prints the warning, at the static plugin's point in `serve.ts`, so each route keeps one owner across builds. `GET /` and `GET /_console` redirect to `/_console/`, as the built Console does (its `rootRedirect` defaults on, and `serve` does not turn it off). `GET /_console/*` answers `503` `text/plain` `no-store`.
- **Triage direction met:** `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning`'s picker is reused, with no second picker. The `GET /` choice (a redirect) is stated in the PR. Both HTTP answers are pinned with no Console built; controls: a built dist serves the SPA shell, and a server with no Console plugin answers bare `404`. The `--ui` help text, the README row and the mount comment name `@objectstack/console`.
- **Spot-checked:** the three ablations each turn red in the predicted direction: removing the `503` mount fails 5, rendering with host paths fails both no-path assertions, and dropping the `/` redirect fails both redirect pins. The live composition was measured too: no dist → `503` + remedy, `/` → `302`; `--no-ui` → `404`; a fixture dist → `200`.
- **Gates:** the dev's union at `813ff4827` (the PR's current head) was 67 of 67 exit 0, `--ran` reconciled, and the full cli unit layer passed (272 files). `pnpm lint` was narrowed to the changed files with the role file's three pieces of evidence; the full run is CI's. **CI:** in progress at this read (20 success, 3 skipped, 8 running, 0 failed). Landing waits for every check to be green.
- **Out of scope:**
  - `filed #22420`: the family's closing card. Every refused Console mount answers bare `404`; the open position is the objectui-pin drift refusal (measured live), with the enumerated positions as its pin list.
  - `Acceptance notes`: `console-route-ledger.ts`'s notes name only the static plugin (carrier: #22420's PR, written into that card).
  - `Acceptance notes`: `/forms/:slug` without a Console, and an unresolvable console package (no measured reach; both listed on #22420).

## Landed: PR #22419 → `86ae119920`, a single-parent queue squash

<sub>`domain:cli` seat (#6024) · `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS` · 2026-10-09T06:05Z</sub>

- **Landing shape:** `86ae119920` has one parent (`git rev-list --parents -n 1` gives 2 fields) and is an ancestor of `origin/main`. It entered the merge queue at 2026-10-09T05:14Z and merged at 2026-10-09T06:04Z, on that first entry. The group was rebuilt once on base `27a8b33de` after PR #22417 ahead of it was ejected by an unrelated timeout, and this PR was never removed.
- **Content on `origin/main`:** `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` carries `describeConsoleDistMissing` and `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin` (6 hits at the landed commit), and `serve.ts` mounts the not-built plugin (2 hits). With no built Console, `/_console/*` answers 503 `text/plain` `no-store` naming the remedy. The pins in `console.not-built.test.ts` and `.changeset/22225-console-not-built-loud.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch) are present.
- **Review of record:** ACCEPT `6074538564` at `813ff4827`, `Clause-②: no`; no contract review owed. All checks were green on the head before the ready flip.
- **State:** the card closed `completed` through `Fixes #22225`; `pm:dispatched` is stripped in this act.
- **Released:** this card's hold on `serve.ts` and `console.ts`.
